pages.text: The blocks of a $(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l)'s $(l)shell$(): the more of them around the crystal, the higher the tier and the more it stores. They are crafted four at a time.$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): 3x3x3, 26$(br)$(li)$(l)3$(): 5x5x5, 98

The shell is a hollow cube of $(item)Resonance Cell$()s $(l)right above the pedestal$(), centred on it: 3x3x3 for tier 2, 5x5x5 for tier 3, 7x7x7 for tier 4. Every block of the cube's surface must be a cell and its $(l)inside must stay empty$(). When the last cell goes in, the cells vanish and the crystal grows to fill
pages.title: Building the shell

pages.text: the shell. The $(l:basics/multiblock_projector)Multiblock Projector$(/l) shows every tier, pylons included: sneak + right-click to pick it, then click the pedestal.$(br)$(li)Breaking a cell of the shell drops the core back a tier, and $(l)the energy that no longer fits is lost$(): empty the core before rebuilding it.
